An Information-Theoretic Regularizer for Lossy Neural Image Compression

用于有损神经图像压缩的信息论正则项

10 页原论文 · 条件信源熵 / 量化优化 / 训练期正则化 · 离线阅读

它与 TagEntropy 的共同问题是如何进一步省比特，但方法是在训练中加入信息论约束，而非更换部署时的潜变量概率模型。

学习导读 · 以下为阅读辅助分析，与论文译文分开

先建立理解框架

核心问题

量化不可微，AUN、STE 等近似带来训练不匹配或梯度偏差。作者从信息论等式出发，为率失真训练增加结构正则项，改善优化和域外泛化。

两种条件熵

直接编码且解码为双射时，H(U)=H(X)−H(X|X̂)。变换编码中合成变换未必可逆，需要补 H(U|X̂)：H(U)=H(X)−H(X|X̂)+H(U|X̂)。前者是给定重建后原始信源的不确定性，后者是重建无法区分的潜变量信息，含义不同。

简化不是严格等价

完整目标是最大化 H(X|X̂)−H(U|X̂)。为降低建模难度，实际只保留 H(X|X̂)，因此不是对任意神经编解码器都严格等价的新码率公式。条件熵差距及分布估计误差仍在，不能由简化本身保证随训练必然消失。

两个优化方向

压缩模型最小化 R+λD+αE[log q_θ(X|X̂)]，额外项近似负条件熵。信源模型最大化 E[log q_θ(X|X̂)]，拟合条件分布。方向相反，因此每步先更新压缩网络，再冻结它、更新信源模型。推理删除 q_θ，不增加码流或推理计算。

结果与成本

测试超先验、自回归、注意力、ELIC、MLIC++。Kodak 的 BD-Rate 收益约0.84%至1.82%，不同数据及阶段另有数值；不能与跨生成编解码器的几十个百分点直接比较。训练耗时增加约8.1%至39.3%。潜变量与信源熵模型结构匹配很关键，信源模型更强不一定更好。

与你的 SAEM-ICMH 对照

TagEntropy 改进部署时的条件概率尺度预测，本文改变训练优化，原则上可能互补。GDFA 同样是训练监督，但依据扩散特征一致性，不等于条件熵。若尝试结合，应保持码率、训练步数、随机种子和初始化一致，报告新增训练成本，并检验视觉和机器任务是否共同受益。

自检问题

变换编码为何多出 H(U|X̂)？最大化条件信源熵为何仍需要失真约束？两个优化器符号为何相反？额外网络为何可在推理删除？正则权重过大会放大什么误差？

An Information-Theoretic Regularizer for Lossy Neural Image Compression

用于有损神经图像压缩的信息论正则项

1Department of Computer Science, City University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong, China 2School of Data Science, Lingnan University, Hong Kong, China 3Bytedance Inc., San Diego, USA

1 香港城市大学计算机科学系，中国香港。2 岭南大学数据科学学院，中国香港。3 字节跳动，美国圣迭戈。

Abstract

摘要

Lossy image compression networks aim to minimize the latent entropy of images while adhering to specific distortion constraints.

有损图像压缩网络旨在满足特定失真约束的同时，最小化图像潜变量的熵。

However, optimizing the neural network can be challenging due to its nature of learning quantized latent representations.

然而，由于需要学习量化的潜在表示，神经网络优化具有挑战性。

In this paper, our key finding is that minimizing the latent entropy is, to some extent, equivalent to maximizing the conditional source entropy, an insight that is deeply rooted in information-theoretic equalities.

本文的关键发现是，最小化潜变量熵在一定程度上等价于最大化条件信源熵，这一认识根植于信息论等式。

Building on this insight, we propose a novel structural regularization method for the neural image compression task by incorporating the negative conditional source entropy into the training objective, such that both the optimization efficacy and the model’s generalization ability can be promoted.

基于此，我们提出新的神经图像压缩结构正则化方法，将负条件信源熵加入训练目标，以改善优化效果和泛化能力。

The proposed information-theoretic regularizer is interpretable, plug-and-play, and imposes no inference overheads.

所提出的信息论正则项可解释、即插即用，且不增加推理开销。

Extensive experiments demonstrate its superiority in regularizing the models and further squeezing bits from the latent representation across various compression structures and unseen domains.

大量实验表明，它能够在多种压缩结构和未见领域中有效正则化模型，并进一步减少潜在表示所需的比特。

Code is available at Github.

代码见 Github。

1. Introduction

1. 引言

Lossy image compression, or more broadly, lossy data compression, is grounded in a fundamental theorem in information theory: the rate-distortion theorem [1].

有损图像压缩，更一般地说有损数据压缩，以信息论中的率失真定理[1]为基础。

Essentially, this theorem establishes a theoretical lower bound for lossy compression and provides valuable guidance for designing practical compression algorithms [2, 3].

该定理给出有损压缩的理论下界，并为实际压缩算法设计提供重要指导[2,3]。

A basic lossy image compression model is illustrated in Fig.1(a).

图1(a)展示基本有损图像压缩模型。

Let X, ˆ X, and U denote the source, the reconstruction, and the discrete index (or the latent), respectively.

设 X、X̂ 和 U 分别表示信源、重建和离散索引，亦即潜变量。

The encoder is a deterministic mapping Q: X N →U, where X N denotes a N-dimensional image space and U = {1, 2, ..., M} denotes the discrete index space.

编码器为确定性映射 Q:Xᴺ→U，其中 Xᴺ 为 N 维图像空间，U={1,2,…,M} 为离散索引空间。

The decoder

解码器为双射映射。

Figure 1.

图1. (a)直接编码模型；

(a) Direct coding model; (b) Information diagram for the direct coding, wherein H(X) = H(X| ˆ X) + H(U) and H(X) is fixed for any known source;

(b)直接编码的信息图，其中 H(X)=H(X|X̂)+H(U)，对于给定信源，H(X)固定；

(c) Transform coding model (with possible side information ˆ Z [4]).

(c)变换编码模型，可包含边信息 Ẑ [4]。

is a bijection mapping Q−1: U →ˆ X N, where the reconstruction space ˆ X N = {c1, ..., cM} forms a N-dimensional codebook.

解码器 Q⁻¹:U→X̂ᴺ 为双射，其中重建空间 X̂ᴺ={c₁,…,c_M} 构成 N 维码本。

For index U, entropy coding is applied to losslessly convert the data into the bitstream, which can then be decoded back to U on the decoder side.

对索引 U 进行熵编码，无损转换为码流，并在解码端恢复 U。

We may refer to such a model as the direct coding model for its structural simplicity.

由于结构简单，可将其称为直接编码模型。

Subsequently, following the rate-distortion theorem [1], given a bounded distortion measure d(·) and a distortion constraint D, the rate of transmitting U is lower bounded by the informational rate-distortion function:

随后，根据率失真定理[1]，给定有界失真度量 d(·) 和失真约束 D，传输 U 所需码率的下界是信息率失真函数：

i.e., the minimum mutual information obtained by traversing all the possible encoder-decoder (or quantizer) designs p ˆ X|X.

即遍历所有可能的编码器—解码器，或量化器设计 p(X̂|X)，所获得的最小互信息。

Theoretically, this bound can be achieved asymptotically using vector quantization as N →∞[5].

理论上，当 N→∞ 时，向量量化能够渐近达到该下界[5]。

However, since the encoding complexity grows exponentially with the image dimension N, a suboptimal yet more practical solution is the transform coding [6]. As depicted in

然而，编码复杂度随图像维数 N 指数增长，因此更实用但次优的方案是变换编码[6]。

Fig.1(c), for the transform coding model, a deterministic analysis transform TA: X N →YM and a deterministic synthesis transform TS: ˆYM →ˆ X N are incorporated into the compression chain.

如图1(c)所示，变换编码模型在压缩链路中引入确定性分析变换 T_A:Xᴺ→Yᴹ 和确定性合成变换 T_S:Ŷᴹ→X̂ᴺ。

The analysis transform is designed to decorrelate the source X, such that a much simpler quantization scheme, e.g., uniform scalar quantization: ui = round(yi), can be independently applied to each dimension of the transformed coefficients Y .

分析变换旨在去除信源 X 的相关性，使得可对变换系数 Y 的每一维独立应用更简单的量化方案，例如均匀标量量化 u_i=round(y_i)。

Building on this framework and leveraging the superior nonlinear capabilities of neural networks, numerous neural image compression networks [4, 7–13] are proposed, continually pushing the frontier of lossy image compression.

基于这一框架并利用神经网络强大的非线性能力，研究者提出大量神经图像压缩网络[4,7–13]，持续推动有损压缩边界。

Typically, by parameterizing the TA and TS in Fig.1(c) as neural networks, the rate-distortion training objective is formulated as [7]:

通常，将图1(c)中的 T_A 和 T_S 参数化为神经网络后，率失真训练目标写为[7]：

where R is the estimation of latent entropy H(U);

其中 R 估计潜变量熵 H(U)；

qϕ is the neural entropy model (or estimated distribution) for U, whose modeling accuracy can be significantly enhanced by transmitting a small amount of side information ˆ Z (as depicted in Fig.1(c)) as part of the parameters ϕ [4];

q_ϕ 是 U 的神经熵模型，即估计分布，可通过传输少量边信息 Ẑ 作为参数 ϕ 的一部分来显著提高建模精度[4]，见图1(c)；

the distortion D is the l2 distance between X and ˆ X;

失真 D 为 X 与 X̂ 的 l₂距离；

λ is the Lagrangian multiplier, controlling the trade-off between R and D.

λ 是控制 R 与 D 权衡的拉格朗日乘子。

Herein, due to the existence of quantization Q(·), U is discrete in essence.

由于存在量化 Q(·)，U 本质上是离散的。

Optimizing the network is then challenging as the gradient is almost zero everywhere for Q(·).

Q(·) 的梯度几乎处处为零，因此网络优化具有挑战性。

To effectively train the networks, a surrogate is introduced during training, e.g., additive uniform noise (AUN) [7]:

为有效训练，需在训练阶段引入替代操作，例如加性均匀噪声（AUN）[7]：

such that the backward gradient of Q(·) is one. However, since such approximation inevitably results in the train-test mismatch, and thus high gradient estimation error [14], both the efficiency and efficacy of the optimization are hindered.

使 Q(·) 的反向梯度为1。然而，这种近似不可避免地导致训练—测试不匹配，从而产生较大的梯度估计误差[14]，妨碍优化效率与效果。

To address this, many research efforts are devoted to designing advanced surrogates and optimization methods [14–18].

为此，许多研究致力于设计先进的替代函数与优化方法[14–18]。

In this paper, we present a completely distinct view on facilitating the optimization of the compression network: regularization.

本文从完全不同的视角促进压缩网络优化，即正则化。

Conceivably, imposing structural constraints on the network optimization can effectively regularize the gradient estimation error, promote convergence, and reduce overfitting.

可以预期，对网络优化施加结构约束，能够约束梯度估计误差、促进收敛并减少过拟合。

In the context of generative variational autoencoders [19], structural regularization techniques [20–25] have been effectively applied to improve authentic data generation.

在生成式变分自编码器[19]中，结构正则化[20–25]已被有效用于改善真实数据生成。

However, since neural compression networks fundamentally differ from generative autoencoders in terms of the minimum latent entropy constraint, to the best of our knowledge, no structural regularization methods tailored to this constraint have been explored.

然而，神经压缩网络受到最小潜变量熵约束，在本质上不同于生成式自编码器；据我们所知，尚未探索专门针对这一约束的结构正则化方法。

In light of this, in this paper, we present the first study of information-theoretic regularization for the neural image compression task.

因此，本文首次研究神经图像压缩的信息论正则化。

In particular, through an in-depth information-theoretic analysis of compression models, we reveal that minimizing the latent entropy H(U) is, to some extent, equally important as maximizing the conditional source entropy H(X| ˆ X).

具体而言，通过深入分析压缩模型，揭示最小化 H(U) 在一定程度上与最大化 H(X|X̂) 同等重要。

Subsequently, by enforcing the network to simultaneously minimize −H(X| ˆ X), both the in-domain compact representation and out-of-domain generalization ability are experimentally improved.

随后，通过约束网络同时最小化 −H(X|X̂)，实验表明域内紧凑表示和域外泛化能力均得到改善。

2. Related works

2. 相关工作

Neural image compression networks. Neural image compression networks are primarily composed of transform, quantization, and latent entropy models.

神经图像压缩网络：主要包含变换、量化和潜变量熵模型。

The transform module maps the input source into a latent representation so that the dependencies of the source domain can be more easily handled.

变换模块将输入信源映射到潜在表示，使信源依赖关系更易处理。

Unlike the linear transform [26] used in traditional hybrid coding, the neural transform is inherently nonlinear, enabling more effective decorrelation of the source data.

不同于传统混合编码中的线性变换[26]，神经变换本质上非线性，可更有效地去除相关性。

In the literature, various neural transform architectures are proposed. Representative architectures include the recurrent neural network (RNN) [27], convolutional neural network (CNN) [7], non-local attention [28], transformer [29], mixed transformer-CNN [30], state-space models [13] and invertible networks [31].

已有研究提出多种结构，包括循环神经网络[27]、卷积神经网络[7]、非局部注意力[28]、Transformer [29]、Transformer–CNN混合结构[30]、状态空间模型[13]和可逆网络[31]。

Subsequently, the continuous transformed coefficients are quantized into the discrete representation, wherein the uniform scalar quantization [7] is commonly adopted.

随后，将连续变换系数量化为离散表示，常用均匀标量量化[7]。

As vector quantization can, in principle, better approach the rate-distortion bound (Eqn.(1)), low-complexity vector quantization [15, 32, 33] and dependent scalar quantization [34, 35] schemes are also studied.

由于向量量化在原则上更接近式(1)的率失真下界，低复杂度向量量化[15,32,33]和依赖标量量化[34,35]也受到研究。

Finally, once the quantized latent representations are obtained, a neural entropy model is essential for performing entropy coding.

最后，获得量化潜变量后，需要神经熵模型执行熵编码。

Herein, since the latent cannot be perfectly decorrelated, an accurate entropy model that can better capture the dependencies and closely match the ground-truth latent distribution is crucial for the overall network performance.

潜变量无法完全去相关，因此准确捕捉依赖关系、紧密匹配真实潜变量分布的熵模型，对整体性能至关重要。

Prominent research directions such as spatial-channel context mining [8, 9, 12, 36], expressive latent distribution modeling [10, 37, 38] and latent architecture designs [4, 11, 39] are explored.

主要方向包括空间—通道上下文挖掘[8,9,12,36]、表达能力更强的潜变量分布建模[10,37,38]，以及潜变量架构设计[4,11,39]。

Optimization over quantized latent representations. The surrogate-based methods [7, 14–17] have been shown to effectively address the non-differentiable quantization function during end-to-end optimization.

量化潜在表示上的优化：基于替代函数的方法[7,14–17]已被证明能有效处理端到端优化中的不可微量化。

In addition to AUN [7], various quantization surrogates such as soft assignment [15], Gumbel-softmax trick [16], and soft rounding function [17] have been studied.

除 AUN [7] 外，还研究了软分配[15]、Gumbel-softmax技巧[16]和软舍入函数[17]。

However, as the surrogate introduces a train-test mismatch in forward calculations, the annealing techniques [14–17] are then proposed to control the “softness” of surrogates, gradually approximating the hard quantization function as training progresses.

然而，替代函数在前向计算中引入训练—测试不匹配，因此提出退火技术[14–17]控制“软度”，随着训练进行逐渐逼近硬量化。

The straight-through estimator (STE) [40] provides an alternative approach to address the train-test mismatch by enforcing an identity mapping during the backward calculation, thereby enabling direct hard quantization in the forward pass.

直通估计器（STE）[40]提供另一方案，在反向计算中强制采用恒等映射，使前向可直接硬量化。

Nevertheless, STE ultimately introduces a significant gradient estimation bias for the analysis transform.

但 STE 最终会给分析变换引入明显梯度估计偏差。

To counter this, an additional fine-tuning stage for the entropy model and synthesis transform is suggested [18].

为此，有研究建议增加熵模型和合成变换的微调阶段[18]。

While numerous network optimization methods have been developed from a quantization perspective, the regularization view has largely escaped research attention.

尽管从量化角度提出了许多优化方法，正则化视角仍少受关注。

To the best of our knowledge, the most related efforts are regularization methods for variational autoencoders (VAEs), such as regularization on latent priors [20–22], reconstruction [23, 24], and consistency [25].

据我们所知，最相关工作是 VAE 正则化，包括潜变量先验[20–22]、重建[23,24]和一致性[25]正则化。

However, as VAEs are designed for generative modeling, these methods are not applicable to optimizing compression networks.

然而，VAE 面向生成建模，这些方法不能直接用于压缩网络优化。

To bridge this knowledge gap, this paper proposes a structural regularizer for neural image compression and conducts extensive experiments to demonstrate its superiority.

为弥补这一空缺，本文提出神经图像压缩结构正则项，并通过大量实验展示优势。

3. Methodology

3. 方法

In this section, we begin by deriving the equivalent maximization form of the latent entropy minimization problem for both the direct and transform coding models.

本节首先针对直接编码与变换编码，推导潜变量熵最小化问题的等价最大化形式。

Building on this derivation, we propose a novel regularization method for optimizing the neural compression network.

基于推导，提出优化神经压缩网络的新正则化方法。

Note that during our derivations, we use the naive transform coding model without the side information branch (i.e., the ˆ Z depicted in Fig 1(c)).

推导中采用不含边信息分支，即图1(c)中 Ẑ 的简单变换编码模型。

This significantly simplifies our analysis without compromising much practicality, as it has been shown that the information flowing into the side branch is negligible compared to the latent branch [4].

这显著简化分析，且不会过多损害实用性，因为已有研究表明，相比主潜变量分支，流入边信息分支的信息很少[4]。

3.1. Motivation: from minimization to maximization

3.1. 动机：从最小化到最大化

(a) Equivalence of minimization and maximization.

From Theorem 2, for any known source X, minimizing H(U) can be equivalently achieved by maximizing the H(X| ˆ X) −H(U| ˆ X). For a bijection synthesis function TS, of which H(U| ˆ X) is zero, this maximization objective is reduced to H(X| ˆ X), which is the same as the direct coding;

根据式(10)，最小化 H(U) 同时最小化 I(X;X̂) 和 H(U|X̂)。

3.2. Information-theoretic regularizer

3.2. 信息论正则项

In principle, optimizing neural compression networks with a quantization surrogate, e.g., AUN, introduces gradient estimation errors [14], thereby deviating the objective of minimizing the latent entropy H(U) under certain distortion constraints (Eqn.(2)), harming both the efficiency and efficacy of the optimization.

原则上，使用 AUN 等量化替代函数优化神经压缩网络会引入梯度估计误差[14]，从而偏离式(2)中在特定失真约束下最小化 H(U) 的目标，损害优化效率与效果。

Motivated by the equivalence of the minimization and maximization optimization discussed in Sec. 3.1, we propose to address this issue by imposing structural maximization constraints on the optimization process.

受第3.1节最小化与最大化等价关系启发，我们通过在优化过程中施加结构性最大化约束解决这一问题。

As such, the vanilla objective of minimizing H(U) can be further enhanced through this maximization regularization.

这样，原始 H(U) 最小化目标可由最大化正则化进一步增强。

From Theorem 2, an ideal gradient direction for model updating is one that simultaneously maximizes H(X| ˆ X)− H(U| ˆ X), which can be further interpreted as maximizing H(X| ˆ X) while minimizing H(U| ˆ X).

根据定理2，理想的更新梯度方向应同时最大化 H(X|X̂)−H(U|X̂)，可进一步解释为最大化 H(X|X̂) 并最小化 H(U|X̂)。

To integrate this regularization into the training objective, two parameterized distributions qθ(X| ˆ X) and qφ(U| ˆ X) are necessitated.

若将其加入训练目标，需要两个参数化分布 q_θ(X|X̂) 和 q_φ(U|X̂)。

However, accurately modeling an entropy model qφ(U| ˆ X) alongside the compression network is quite challenging, as it involves learning another “encoder” function from the reconstruction ˆ X to the latent U.

然而，随压缩网络同时准确建模 q_φ(U|X̂) 很困难，因为这相当于再学习一个从重建 X̂ 到潜变量 U 的“编码器”。

We experimentally find that a poorly learned H(U| ˆ X) regularizer may harm the optimization performance, and that the increased training complexity is also burdensome.

实验发现，学习不充分的 H(U|X̂) 正则项可能损害优化，增加的训练复杂度也很沉重。

To balance practical feasibility with regularization accuracy, we include only the first H(X| ˆ X) term for regularization, which is an upper bound for the ground-truth H(X| ˆ X) −H(U| ˆ X) objective.

为平衡可行性与精确性，我们仅将第一项 H(X|X̂) 用于正则化，它是真实目标 H(X|X̂)−H(U|X̂) 的上界。

The entropy modeling becomes more tractable since the reconstruction ˆ X is closely aligned with the source X.

由于重建 X̂ 与信源 X 紧密对齐，熵建模更容易。

The primary rationale for such simplification is that although maximizing H(X| ˆ X) alone is less precise than H(X| ˆ X) − H(U| ˆ X), it still provides a meaningful constraint on the ”noisy” gradient, yielding better gradient direction than no regularization.

简化的主要理由是，虽然单独最大化 H(X|X̂) 不如完整差值精确，仍能对“含噪”梯度提供有意义约束，比没有正则化给出更好方向。

Another justification is that since we will retain the H(U) minimization term in the overall objective, this H(U| ˆ X) gap, in principle (Eqn.(11)), should decrease as training progresses, which ensures that the regularization effect remains aligned with the ideal maximization objective.

另一个理由是，总目标仍保留 H(U) 最小化项，原则上根据式(11)，随着训练推进，H(U|X̂) 差距应减小，从而使正则效果继续接近理想最大化目标。

The resulting training objective is thus given by:

最终训练目标如下：

where R + λD follows the rate-distortion loss in Eqn.(2);

其中 R+λD 为式(2)的率失真损失；

−H(X| ˆ X) is the proposed regularizer;

−H(X|X̂) 是所提正则项；

qθ(X| ˆ X) is the estimated source distribution;

q_θ(X|X̂) 是估计的信源分布；

α is regularization factor, controlling the degree of regularization.

α 为控制正则强度的系数。

An illustration for this regularization method is given in Fig.(2).

图2展示该方法。

In addition to the compression network, qθ(X| ˆ X) is introduced, which is parameterized by a neural network and can be optimized via the maximum likelihood criteria [41]:

除压缩网络外，引入神经网络参数化的 q_θ(X|X̂)，可通过最大似然准则[41]优化：

This results in a max-min optimization problem where minimizing −H(X| ˆ X) (Eqn.(12)) simultaneously creates a conflict.

由此产生极大—极小优化问题，因为同时最小化式(12)的 −H(X|X̂) 会形成冲突。

To resolve this, a GAN-style two-stage joint training strategy [42] is employed: At each training step, we first update the compression network using Eqn.(12), then freeze it and update qθ(X| ˆ X) using Eqn.(13).

为解决这一问题，采用类似 GAN 的两阶段联合训练[42]：每个训练步先按式(12)更新压缩网络，再冻结它，按式(13)更新 q_θ(X|X̂)。

We summarize the strategy in Algorithm 1.

算法1总结该策略。

4. Experiments

4. 实验

4.1. Experimental setup

4.1. 实验设置

Compression models. Three classic image compression models are used in exhaustive validation experiments: the hyperprior context model [4] (with scale and mean [8]), the joint hyperprior and spatial autoregressive context model [8], and the attention-based transform model [10]. We may refer to these models as hyperprior, autoregressive, and attention, respectively.

压缩模型：使用三种经典图像压缩模型进行充分验证，即含尺度与均值[8]的超先验上下文模型[4]、联合超先验与空间自回归上下文模型[8]、基于注意力的变换模型[10]，分别简称超先验、自回归、注意力模型。

Moreover, we conduct the experiments on two advanced compression models: ELIC [43] and MLIC++ [12].

此外，在先进的 ELIC [43] 和 MLIC++ [12] 上实验。

Notably, ELIC utilizes checkerboard and channel-conditioned latent entropy contexts, while MLIC++ builds upon ELIC by introducing additional attention-based context designs and is identified as one of the state-of-the-art (SOTA) models.

ELIC 使用棋盘格与通道条件潜变量熵上下文，MLIC++ 在其基础上加入注意力上下文，是领先模型之一。

We train these models from scratch using the vanilla ratedistortion loss (Eqn.(2)), and compare their performance when trained with the proposed regularization method (Algorithm 1) under an equal number of training steps.

各模型均用式(2)的普通率失真损失从头训练，并与相同训练步数下使用算法1正则化的方法比较。

For the implementations of the hyperprior, autoregressive, and attention models, we adopt CompressAI’s reimplementation [44], where the quantization surrogate is ANU.

前三种模型采用 CompressAI 的复现[44]，量化替代方式为 AUN。

For ELIC and MLIC++, we use the open reimplementations from [45] and the official implementation, respectively, both of which employ a mixed ANU-STE quantization surrogate [9].

ELIC 使用文献[45]的公开复现，MLIC++ 使用官方实现，二者均采用混合 AUN–STE 量化替代[9]。

Conditional source entropy modeling. For each compression model, we apply exactly the same entropy modeling architecture as the latent entropy modeling qϕ(U| ˆ Z).

条件信源熵建模：每种压缩模型的信源熵建模架构均与潜变量熵模型 q_ϕ(U|Ẑ) 相同。

Our experiments indicate that aligning the entropy model between the latent and source is critical for effective regularization;

实验表明，潜变量与信源熵模型对齐对有效正则化至关重要；

deviations in either direction (stronger or weaker source models) degrade compression performance.

无论信源模型更强还是更弱，偏离都会损害压缩性能。

For the hyperprior model [4], qθ(X| ˆ X) is modeled as the factorized Gaussian distribution conditioned on ˆ X, i.e., and fθ is modeled by convolutional layers;

对超先验模型[4]，q_θ(X|X̂) 建模为以 X̂ 为条件的因子化高斯分布，具体公式如下。

N denotes the Gaussian distribution; Φ denote the mean and variance; N denotes the dimension of both X and ˆ X.

f_θ 由卷积层建模，𝒩 表示高斯分布，Φ 表示均值与方差，N 表示 X 与 X̂ 的维度。

For both the autoregressive and attention models, the mean and variance are determined by the additional spatial context, i.e., where X<i denotes the pixels before the current position and is captured by a 5 × 5 masked convolution layer.

对自回归与注意力模型，均值和方差还取决于额外空间上下文，如公式所示，其中 X_<i 表示当前位置之前的像素，通过5×5掩码卷积捕捉。

For ELIC, Φ is divided by a checkerboard pattern, leading to the anchor part Φanchor and the non-anchor part Φnon-anchor.

对 ELIC，按棋盘格划分 Φ，得到锚点 Φ_anchor 与非锚点 Φ_non-anchor。

Both the original frame X and Φ are split into 3 slices for context modeling.

原图 X 与 Φ 均分为3个切片进行上下文建模。

In the first slice, Φ1 anchor is directly determined by ˆ X, while Φ1 non-anchor is determined by an additional spatial context from X1 anchor. For kth (k > 1) slice, both the Φk anchor and Φk non-anchor are conditioned on extra channel context from previous slices X<k.

第一个切片中，Φ¹_anchor 直接由 X̂ 决定，Φ¹_non-anchor 还依赖 X¹_anchor 提供的空间上下文。对于第 k 个切片，k>1，两类 Φ 都依赖此前切片 X_<k 的额外通道上下文。

For MLIC++, following its latent entropy modeling [12], the checkerboard attention module is employed to capture the local dependencies within each slice.

对 MLIC++，遵循其潜变量熵建模[12]，采用棋盘格注意力捕捉每个切片内的局部依赖。

Additionally, the intra attention module, which takes the original anchor slice Xk anchor and the previous slice Xk−1 as input, captures global dependencies within slices.

此外，切片内注意力以当前原始锚点切片 Xᵏ_anchor 和前一切片 Xᵏ⁻¹ 为输入，捕捉切片内全局依赖；

Furthermore, the inter attention module is introduced to capture the global dependency of inter slices.

切片间注意力则捕捉跨切片的全局依赖。

The detailed network structure of qθ(X| ˆ X) for different models is illustrated in Fig. 3.

各模型 q_θ(X|X̂) 的网络结构见图3。

For further details on the convolutional modules, intra-attention module, interattention module, and checkerboard attention module, readers may refer to the Supplementary Material (Sec. 9).

卷积、切片内注意力、切片间注意力和棋盘格注意力的进一步细节见补充材料第9节。

All experiments are conducted on Nvidia RTX 4090 GPUs.

所有实验在 NVIDIA RTX 4090 上进行。

性能评估：按惯例在自然图像数据集 Kodak [48]、CLIC 2024 验证集[49]和 Tecnick [50]上评估。

4.2. Results

4.2. 结果

Performance on natural images. In Fig.4, we present the BD-Rate comparison at four different training steps.

自然图像性能：图4比较四个训练步数下的 BD-Rate。

The anchor is trained with the vanilla rate-distortion loss (Eqn.(2)) under an equal number of training steps.

基准在相同步数下使用式(2)普通率失真损失。

The regularization factors α for the hyperprior, autoregressive, attention, ELIC, and MLIC++ models are set to 0.1, 1, 1, 0.1, and 0.1, respectively.

超先验、自回归、注意力、ELIC、MLIC++ 的 α 分别为0.1、1、1、0.1、0.1。

It can be observed that, for training steps beyond 0.5 × 106 across all five models, our proposed regularization method can achieve better compression performance than the vanilla optimization method.

可以看到，五个模型在训练超过0.5×10⁶步后，所提方法均优于普通优化。

In particular, at the 2 × 106 step, the average BD-Rates for hyperprior, autoregressive, and attention are -0.88%, -1.06% and -0.92%, respectively;

具体而言，在2×10⁶步时，前三者平均 BD-Rate 分别为−0.88%、−1.06%、−0.92%；

at the 1 × 106 step, the average BD-Rates for ELIC and MLIC++ are -1.56% and -3.03%, respectively.

在1×10⁶步时，ELIC 和 MLIC++ 分别为−1.56%、−3.03%。

Meanwhile, the results demonstrate that the regularization effect varies across models as training progresses: For the hyperprior, autoregressive, and MLIC++ models, after a brief convergence period, the BD-Rates are gradually improved from 0 to around -1%. For the ELIC model, the regularization is most effective during the earlier training stages, achieving over 2.5% BD-Rates saving at the 0.25 × 106 step.

同时，正则效果随模型和训练进程而变化。对超先验、自回归、MLIC++，短暂收敛后 BD-Rate 从0逐渐改善至约−1%。对 ELIC，早期训练效果最明显，在0.25×10⁶步达到超过2.5%的码率节省。

For the attention model, the regularization achieves a relatively stable coding gain.

注意力模型的收益则较稳定。

In Fig. 5, we present the detailed rate-distortion curves on the Kodak dataset.

图5展示 Kodak 的详细率失真曲线。

For the hyperprior, autoregressive, and attention models, the results correspond to the 2 × 106 training step, while for the ELIC and MLIC++ models, the results are from the 1 × 106 step.

前三种模型采用2×10⁶步结果，ELIC 和 MLIC++ 采用1×10⁶步结果。

The results indicate that the introduction of the additional conditional source entropy regularization leads to a slight reduction in the bit rate for most of the points, although a few exceptions exhibit an increase due to training noise.

额外的条件信源熵正则化使多数点的码率略微下降，少数点因训练噪声而增加。

From the form of regularization in Eqn.(12), i.e., −αH(X| ˆ X), the extent of such bit rate reduction depends on both the regularization factor α and the estimated conditional source entropy H(X| ˆ X).

根据式(12)的 −αH(X|X̂)，下降程度取决于 α 与估计的条件信源熵 H(X|X̂)。

Generalizing on unseen domains. In machine learning, regularization plays an essential role in preventing overfitting and enhancing generalization.

未见领域泛化：在机器学习中，正则化对防止过拟合和增强泛化至关重要。

In Table 1, we directly apply the models trained on natural images to the four unseen domains and evaluate the effectiveness of our regularization method.

表1直接将自然图像训练的模型用于四个未见领域，评估正则化效果。

The results indicate that, across all new domains, regularized models consistently outperform unregularized ones.

结果表明，在所有新领域中，正则化模型持续优于未正则化模型。

Performance improvements vary by domain and model, with notable gains in some cases.

改善幅度随领域和模型而异，部分情况收益明显。

For instance, in the pathology domain with the attention model, the regularization achieves a BD-Rate of -2.38%, more than double the improvement observed in the natural domain.

例如，注意力模型在病理领域达到−2.38%的 BD-Rate，改善幅度超过自然图像领域的两倍。

Effect of α and longer training. In Fig.(6)(a), we continue training both the unregularized and regularized hyperprior models to 4 × 106 steps and demonstrate the effect of the regularization factor α on the performance.

α 与更长训练的影响：图6(a)将有无正则化的超先验模型继续训练至4×10⁶步，并展示 α 的影响。

Herein, with extended training, the regularization consistently enhances optimization.

延长训练后，正则化仍持续改善优化。

The best performance, with α = 1, is achieved at the 2.5 × 106 step, showing a BD-Rate of - 1.24%. As training progresses to 4 × 106 steps, the gain reduces to around 0.7%.

α=1 时，在2.5×10⁶步取得最佳−1.24% BD-Rate；到4×10⁶步时，收益降至约0.7%。

For the effect of hyperparameter α, it is shown that either the value is too large or too small will not benefit the optimization, which can be explained as follows. As discussed in Sec. 3.2, our αH(X| ˆ X) maximization regularization is a bound upper of the groundtruth objective α(H(X| ˆ X) −H(U| ˆ X)).

α 过大或过小均不利，解释如下。如第3.2节所述，αH(X|X̂) 最大化正则目标是真实目标 α[H(X|X̂)−H(U|X̂)] 的上界。

When α is large, this H(U| ˆ X) gap is also amplified, which may harm the regularization accuracy and thus the optimization performance.

α 较大时，H(U|X̂) 差距也被放大，可能损害正则精度和优化性能。

While one might consider addressing this through additional H(U| ˆ X) estimation using Algorithm 1, such an approach proves generally ineffective.

虽然可以考虑按算法1额外估计 H(U|X̂)，但通常无效。

The challenge lies in accurately learning a distribution qφ(U| ˆ X) that maps ˆ X to U, as any discrepancy between qφ(U| ˆ X) and the true p(U| ˆ X) would itself reduce accuracy. Furthermore, the incurred computational overhead is unfavorable.

困难在于准确学习从 X̂ 映射到 U 的 q_φ(U|X̂)，其与真实 p(U|X̂) 的任何差异都会降低精度，而且额外计算开销不理想。

We provide more results in Supplementary Material (Sec. 10).

更多结果见补充材料第10节。

When α is small, the regularizer has little contribution to the overall loss, and the optimization is reduced to the vanilla objective.

α 较小时，正则项对总损失贡献很小，优化退化为普通目标。

Figure 6. (a) Effects of regularization factor α.

图6. (a)正则系数 α 的影响；

(b) Regularization performance for the hyperprior compression model with the autoregressive regularizer;

(b)超先验压缩模型采用自回归正则项的性能；

(c) the autoregressive compression model with the hyperprior regularizer.

(c)自回归压缩模型采用超先验正则项的性能。

On the alignment of the entropy models. In our experimental setup, we emphasize the advantages of aligned entropy modeling between latent and source distributions.

关于熵模型对齐：实验设置强调潜变量和信源分布采用对齐熵模型的优势。

Herein, we extend the analysis to explore cases where the entropy models are unaligned, investigating two scenarios: a compression model equipped with (a) a stronger source entropy model and (b) a weaker source entropy model.

这里进一步研究不对齐情况，即压缩模型采用更强或更弱的信源熵模型。

In particular, for the source models of the hyperprior and autoregressive depicted in Fig.3(a) and Fig.3(b), respectively, we consider the autoregressive entropy model with additional spatial contexts to be a more accurate and thus “stronger” model.

具体而言，对图3(a)、(b)的超先验与自回归信源模型，自回归模型包含额外空间上下文，因此更准确、更“强”。

Thereafter, we train the hyperprior compression model with a autoregressive source regularizer and the autoregressive compression model with a hyperprior source regularizer, and the results are depicted in Fig.6(b) and Fig.6(c), respectively.

随后，用自回归信源正则项训练超先验压缩模型，用超先验正则项训练自回归压缩模型，结果分别见图6(b)、(c)。

The values of α are still set to 0.1 and 1 for the hyperprior and autoregressive regularizers, respectively. The performance of the aligned entropy model is also included for reference.

超先验与自回归正则项的 α 仍分别设为0.1和1，并列出对齐结果供参考。

Herein, it can be observed that neither a stronger nor a weaker source entropy model consistently facilitates the optimization performance of the compression models.

可以看到，更强或更弱的信源模型都不能持续促进压缩模型优化。

Specifically, when a stronger autoregressive regularizer is imposed on the hyperprior network, the average BD-Rate remains positive throughout training.

具体而言，对超先验网络施加强自回归正则项，平均 BD-Rate 在整个训练中始终为正。

When a weaker hyperprior regularizer is employed by the autoregressive network, the optimization is temporarily improved at the 1.5 × 106 training step, with a BD-Rate of -0.20%.

对自回归网络采用较弱超先验正则项，仅在1.5×10⁶步暂时改善，BD-Rate 为−0.20%。

In contrast, aligning the entropy models leads to significant performance improvements.

相比之下，对齐熵模型能显著提升性能。

4.3. Limitations

4.3. 局限

Our regularization method is applied exclusively during the network training stage and therefore introduces no additional inference complexity.

正则化仅在训练阶段使用，因此不增加推理复杂度。

However, since it involves training an additional source entropy model qθ(X| ˆ X), the training complexity is inevitably increased.

然而，由于额外训练 q_θ(X|X̂)，训练复杂度不可避免地增加。

Assuming the complexities of the source and latent entropy models are approximately equal, the complexity overhead ratio can be calculated as CL CL+CT = 1 1+CT /CL , which is closely related to the complexity ratio between the transform backbone and the latent, i.e., CT /CL.

假设信源与潜变量熵模型复杂度近似相等，开销比例可写为 C_L/(C_L+C_T)=1/(1+C_T/C_L)，与变换主干和潜变量熵模型的复杂度比 C_T/C_L 密切相关。

For λ = 0.0018, we train 1 × 105 steps for each model on the same machine (Nvidia RTX 4090) and compute the time ratio.

在 λ=0.0018 时，于同一台 RTX 4090 机器上为每种模型训练10⁵步并计算时间比。

As shown in Table 2, compared to the unregularized baseline, the training time of our proposed method increases by 28.8%, 18.2%, 8.1%, 39.3%, and 29.8% for the hyperprior, autoregressive, attention, ELIC, and MLIC++ models, respectively.

表2显示，相比未正则化基准，超先验、自回归、注意力、ELIC、MLIC++ 的训练时间分别增加28.8%、18.2%、8.1%、39.3%、29.8%。

Notably, for the attention model, the overhead is the least significant.

注意力模型开销最小。

This can be attributed to the fact that the attention-based transform backbone is significantly more complex than the entropy model.

这是因为其变换主干明显比熵模型复杂。

To further reduce training complexity, one can employ lightweight convolutional layers, such as depthwise separable convolution [56], or improve the iterative training strategy outlined in Algorithm 1.

为进一步降低训练复杂度，可采用深度可分离卷积[56]等轻量层，或改进算法1的迭代训练策略。

Table 2. Training complexity of the proposed regularizer compared to the unregularized anchor.

表2. 所提正则项与未正则化基准的训练复杂度比较。

5. Conclusion

5. 结论

This paper investigates a structural entropy regularizer for lossy neural image compression.

本文研究用于有损神经图像压缩的结构熵正则项。

Specifically, motivated by the information-theoretic analysis of compression models, we demonstrate that, in addition to minimizing latent entropy, maximizing conditional source entropy can be equally important.

具体而言，受压缩模型信息论分析启发，说明除了最小化潜变量熵，最大化条件信源熵也可能同样重要。

Subsequently, by regularizing the neural networks to simultaneously maximize the conditional source entropy during end-to-end optimization, we experimentally observe improvements in both the in-domain compact representation and the out-of-domain generalization abilities of compression models.

随后，在端到端优化中正则化网络，使其同时最大化条件信源熵，实验观察到域内紧凑表示和域外泛化能力均得到改善。

Additionally, as the primary overhead of this regularizer comes from training an additional source entropy model, the proposed method imposes no added inference complexity, opening up a new space for regularizing neural compression networks.

此外，主要开销来自训练额外信源熵模型，不增加推理复杂度，为神经压缩网络正则化开辟了新方向。
